ui.title: Create agent
ui.startPlaceholder: e.g. I run a nail spa in Da Nang. Customers ask prices and want to book.
ui.suggestFailed: I could not work that out on my own. Let's go through the questions.
ui.suggested: I filled in what you described. Tap an answer to change it.
ui.draftCreated: Your agent is saved as a draft. Try it on the right.
ui.saveFailed: Could not save your agent. Your answers are kept, and we will retry on the next answer.
ui.done: All set. Activate your agent when you are happy with it.
ui.finished: Your agent is active and replies to customers on every channel linked to it. Keep answering, or change any answer at any time.
ui.promptSummaryIntro: What your agent was told, from your answers. The agent reads it as an English prompt.
ui.testEarlyHint: Once your agent has a name, you can try it right away and finish the rest later.
ui.extraInstructionsHint: Added at the end of what your agent is told. Leave it empty if your answers cover everything.
ui.heroSubtitle: Describe your business, or choose a template
ui.connectFailed: Could not connect this channel. Please try again.
ui.channelLoadFailed: Could not load this channel. You can connect it later.
ui.widgetOriginsLabel: Websites allowed to show the chat (one per line)
ui.channelInUse: {{name}} is already used by another agent. Unlink it there first to use it here.
ui.changeTypeDescription: This agent is live. A new business type resets the answers that depend on it, such as goals, rules and what to collect, and customers see the change as soon as it saves.
ui.hoursInvalid: Check the hours: closing time must be after opening time, and the hours in a day must not overlap.
ui.customCollectLimit: You can add up to {{count}} fields.
ui.activateAsk: Your agent has the basics it needs to reply to customers. Activate it now? The remaining questions are optional and already have defaults for your business type, so you can fine-tune them any time.

businessType.title: What kind of business is this agent for?

placedOrders.ask: What should happen after your agent places an order with the connected order tool? If you pick a notification, you and your team get one in the app (the bell at the top) and by email.
